In a basketball game, a player scored 36 points using only 2-point shots and 3-point shots. She made 14 successful shots in total. How many 2-point and how many 3-point shots did she make?

options.text: Number of 2-point shots = 7; Number of 3-point shots = 7
Number of 2-point shots = 6; Number of 3-point shots = 8
Number of 2-point shots = 8; Number of 3-point shots = 6

questions.key_answer: Number of 2-point shots = 6; Number of 3-point shots = 8
